metadata.title: Universal Game Design Framework
metadata.description: A guided questionnaire to ideate a game before writing a full GDD.

form.title: Universal Game Design Framework
form.description: High-level framework for designing games before writing a GDD.

budget.title: Budget
budget.guide: What budget constraints should influence the design?

teamSize.title: Team Size
teamSize.guide: Who is building this game? What skills are available?

technology.title: Technology
technology.guide: What engine, tools, or physical components will be used?

productionScope.title: Production Scope
productionScope.guide: How ambitious should this project be? What should intentionally remain out of scope?

pitch.title: One-Sentence Pitch
pitch.guide: Describe the game in one sentence.

summary.title: Concept Summary
summary.guide: What is the core idea? Why does this game exist?

desiredExperience.title: Desired Experience
desiredExperience.guide: How should players describe the game after playing?

rules.title: Rules
rules.guide: What fundamental rules define the game?

progressionSystems.title: Progression Systems
progressionSystems.guide: How does the player become more capable?

socialDynamics.title: Social Dynamics
socialDynamics.guide: How do players cooperate or compete?

world.title: World
world.guide: Where does the game take place?

theme.title: Theme
theme.guide: What is the tone and atmosphere?

environmentalStorytelling.title: Environmental Storytelling
environmentalStorytelling.guide: How does the world communicate its history and mood?

coreLoop.title: Core Loop
coreLoop.guide: What actions repeat throughout the game?

sessionFlow.title: Session Flow
sessionFlow.guide: What does a typical play session look like?

longTermProgression.title: Long-Term Progression
longTermProgression.guide: What keeps players engaged across sessions?

shortTerm.title: Short-Term Goals
shortTerm.guide: What should players accomplish in the next few minutes?

midTerm.title: Mid-Term Goals
midTerm.guide: What should players work toward over several sessions?

longTerm.title: Long-Term Goals
longTerm.guide: What ultimate objectives motivate continued play?

victoryConditions.title: Victory Conditions
victoryConditions.guide: How does the player win? Are there multiple paths?

failureConditions.title: Failure Conditions
failureConditions.guide: How can the player fail? What are the consequences?

mastery.title: Mastery
mastery.guide: How can experienced players continue improving?

principle1.title: Principle 1
principle1.guide: What rule should always be followed?

principle3.title: Principle 3
principle3.guide: What question should designers constantly ask?

tradeoffs.title: Trade-offs
tradeoffs.guide: How should conflicts between good design options be resolved?

playerExperience.title: Player Experience
playerExperience.guide: What should playtesters consistently feel or say?

gameplay.title: Gameplay
gameplay.guide: What behaviors indicate the mechanics are working?

redFlags.title: Red Flags
redFlags.guide: What indicates the design is failing?

pillar1.title: Pillar 1
pillar1.guide: What is the most important aspect of this game?

pillar3.title: Pillar 3
pillar3.guide: What experience must never be compromised?

neverBecome.title: Things This Game Should Never Become
neverBecome.guide: What directions would betray the game's identity?
